mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, event_id, app_id, open_id, trigger_type, preset_id, registration_token_exp, message_id, status, skip_reason, errmsg, create_time FROM crm_event_mp_outreach_log WHERE event_id = #{param1} AND open_id = #{param2} AND trigger_type = #{param3} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_event_mp_outreach_log ( tenant_id, event_id, app_id, open_id, trigger_type, preset_id, registration_token_exp, message_id, status, skip_reason, errmsg, create_time ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{eventId}, #{appId}, #{openId}, #{triggerType}, #{presetId}, #{registrationTokenExp}, #{messageId}, #{status}, #{skipReason}, #{errmsg}, now() ) ON CONFLICT (event_id, open_id, trigger_type) DO NOTHING
